claims.interpretation: Both companies' disclosures support a testable hypothesis that customer workload and technology-spending changes can affect operating performance: Datadog says customer usage expands with cloud workloads and warns that IT spending changes may affect its business; Snowflake reports consumption-based product revenue and says customers may optimize consumption in response to macroeconomic uncertainty. claims.temporal_basis: The hypothesis combines operating-model disclosures in two separate annual filings; each source has its own reporting period and neither describes a relationship interval.
